_help._file: How the arena plays its AI-vs-AI games for the Personality Check — `npm run ai:arena` on the PC and the Dev Kit's Run check. The flags (--games, --seats, --ladder, --seed, --skill) change one run without changing this file.
_help.games: Mixed tables per run (npm run ai:arena). Personalities shuffled into tables of minSeats…maxSeats players, one size after the other.
_help.maxSeats: The biggest table. Bigger than the number of personalities = one plays twice.
_help.ladderGames: Skill-ladder games per personality: its highest skill against its lowest, two players. 0 = no ladder.
_help.seed: The first mixed game's seed (game 2 plays seed + 1…). The same seed = the same games = the same report.
_help.notesInReport: How many of the first game's decision notes the report shows.
_help.mainSkill: The skill the mixed tables play at (empty = the middle skill in the game's skills file).
_help.reportPath: Where npm run ai:arena writes the report page, from the game folder.
_help.devKitLadderFrom: The Dev Kit's Run check adds a small skill ladder from this many games asked for.
